summary.text: Nancy VanderMeer is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 70 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Stephanie Stuve Bodeen.
She chairs the Assembly Transportation Committee, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Nancy VanderMeer earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse in 1988.
VanderMeer assumed office in the Assembly on January 5, 2015.

Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Agriculture, Health, Mental Health, Rural Development, Science, Technology, and AI (vice-chair), Transportation (chair), Veterans and Military Affairs, and the Joint Legislative Council.
